_comment: Course Study App — Hands-on Labs & Assignments Index Template. If no lab manuals are used, output '{}'. Keys are bare PDF filenames located in data/labs/.

markdown_and_latex_support.note: ALL STRING FIELDS (title, description, tasks[].title, tasks[].description) SUPPORT FULL GITHUB-FLAVORED MARKDOWN AND KATEX MATH ($inline$ or $$display$$).
markdown_and_latex_support.mandatory_json_backslash_rule: CRITICAL: In JSON strings, the backslash '\' is the JSON escape character. Every LaTeX command MUST use double backslashes '\\'. For example, write '$\alpha$', '$\text{ms}$', '$$\frac{a}{b}$$', and '$O(M \times N)$'. Never write unescaped '\t' or '\f'. Escape literal dollar signs in prose as \$.
markdown_and_latex_support.code_and_math_rules: Use backticks (`$var`) exclusively for code, shell syntax, packet headers, and script variables; use dollar signs ($math$) exclusively for LaTeX math (never nest backticks in math). Never output raw HTML/MathML tags like <span class='katex'> or <math>. Escape literal dollar signs in prose as \$.

_schema_field_definitions.lab_number: String or Integer. Lab identifier (e.g., '1', '2', 'Lab 1', 'Assignment A').
_schema_field_definitions.title: MARKDOWN & LATEX STRING FIELD. Full canonical title of the lab assignment.
_schema_field_definitions.description: MARKDOWN & LATEX STRING FIELD. Brief 1-2 sentence overview of what the lab covers, objectives, and systems evaluated.
_schema_field_definitions.tools: Array of Strings (Optional). Primary tools, utilities, or libraries used (e.g. ['OpenSSL', 'Wireshark', 'GnuPG', 'Python']).
_schema_field_definitions.total_pages: Integer. Total physical pages/sheets in the lab instruction PDF.
_schema_field_definitions.tasks: Array of Task objects defining the exercises, milestones, and page bounds.
_schema_field_definitions.tasks[].task_id: String. Unique kebab-case identifier for this specific task (e.g., 'task-1-1', 'task-1-2', 'task-ecb-modes'). Used for precise citation references when multiple tasks share a page.
_schema_field_definitions.tasks[].title: MARKDOWN & LATEX STRING FIELD. Descriptive title of this specific exercise.
_schema_field_definitions.tasks[].pages: Array of 2 Integers: [start_page, end_page]. 1-indexed inclusive physical PDF page bounds.
